sprint
    .slice(0, 4)
    .map((block: unknown) => {
      const s = block as Record<string, unknown>
      const days = s.days != null ? String(s.days) : ''
      const tasks = Array.isArray(s.tasks) ? (s.tasks as string[]).map(t => `    - ${t}`).join('\n') : ''
      return days ? `${days}\n${tasks}` : tasks
    })
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join
